title: The objects
about: `packages/objects` holds the shapes of the objects Nemia serves and the HttpApi that serves them, read by every layer above the runtime: its words are what an object is and how a list of it is read.

terms.meaning: one thing Nemia serves, of one kind: its `apiVersion`, nemia/v1 (`API_VERSION`), its `kind`, and its `metadata`, which names it and says which change of it a reader holds (`ObjectMeta`, `packages/objects/src/meta.ts`). A kind's spec and status sit beside them.
the type of an object, a word with a capital (`Run`, `Card`), written in its `kind` field; a page of a list of it is the kind `<Kind>List` (`listOf`, `packages/objects/src/meta.ts`).

the folder of names an object's `metadata.namespace` puts it in: a name is unique in its namespace for its kind, and an object nobody gave one is in `default` (`DEFAULT_NAMESPACE`, `packages/objects/src/meta.ts`).

an opaque word in an object's metadata that changes on every write to it: a reader compares it and never orders it, and a writer hands back the one it read to say which change it acted on (`ObjectMeta`, `packages/objects/src/meta.ts`).

the count of changes to an object's spec, for a kind whose spec a person edits (`ObjectMeta`, `packages/objects/src/meta.ts`): a Factory's goes up by one when its repositories, workflows, hires, volumes, harness settings, revisions, template or level change, and a change to its status, or to its schedules alone, leaves it (`Factory`, `packages/objects/src/factory.ts`).
a page of objects of one kind, `{ apiVersion, kind: <Kind>List, metadata, items }`, whose metadata says where the page stands (`ListMeta`, `listOf`, `packages/objects/src/meta.ts`).
the opaque word a page of a list hands back to ask for the next, absent on the last page; a reader sends it back as it is and never builds one (`ListMeta`, `packages/objects/src/meta.ts`).

the query key of a list that keeps the objects whose labels it matches (`team=core`), given again for another, of which each must match (`packages/objects/src/index.ts`, the door it is served through).

retired.card: Resource objects: every kind Nemia serves is a nemia/v1 object

terms.meaning: what a step or a run waits on when the wait is a thing's, not a person's (reason `Waiting`): other runs (`run`), the limit on runs in flight (`limit`), the base branch the run lands on while another run lands there (`base`), the store's pause (`pause`), or a person's hold that names no run, which a person alone lifts (`hold`, `nemia hold` with no `--until`), where a hold that names runs is `run`; a selector names it as `on=<word>` (`WAIT_ON`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`). A feed line written before the rename reads `checkout` as `base`.

retired.card: resource objects, P7: the Run's double spellings go before v1 — one approve, one retry, one refresh, and `base` for what a step waits on

terms.meaning: a person's word on the try a step is on, said one way on the Run (`gate.approval`, `packages/objects/src/run.ts`): an approval at its gate, or, of a looping step out of rounds, its work accepted as it stands — both `nemia approve`.

retired.card: resource objects, P7: the Run's double spellings go before v1 — one approve, one retry, one refresh, and `base` for what a step waits on

terms.meaning: a factory served as an object, which no namespace holds since it is the namespace its parts are in: its spec is what its file says (repositories, workflows, hires, volumes, harness settings, revisions, template, level), its status what the controller last observed (conditions, the applied version, an upgrade waiting, places not trusted, why its file does not read), at `/api/factories/<name>` (`Factory`, `packages/objects/src/factory.ts`).

a remote MCP server a factory records, served as an object in the factory's namespace: its spec the transport, url, masked headers and OAuth client, its status the state its harness reports now; a builtin server Nemia offers is served at `/api/builtin/mcpservers` with its spec alone and no namespace (`McpServer`, `packages/objects/src/mcp-server.ts`).

a factory's schedule of one of its workflows, served as an object in the factory's namespace and named by its workflow: its spec the cron, brief, repository and time zone, its status since when, its next fire, its last run and a refused fire (`Schedule`, `packages/objects/src/schedule.ts`).

one step a factory offers, served as an object in the factory's namespace and named `<workflow>.<step>`: its spec the agent the factory hires into it, its status who fills the step (fill origin) and where each setting a session there gets came from (setting origin) (`Hire`, `packages/objects/src/hire.ts`).

a folder of the person's machine a factory mounts for every local step, served as an object in the factory's namespace by its stored name and read-only over the api: its spec its path and whether steps only read it, its status whether it is there, why a run would refuse it, and the runs in play that mount it (`Volume`, `packages/objects/src/volume.ts`).

the generation of a Factory's spec the controller last read, in its status: equal to `metadata.generation` once the controller has acted on the latest change, behind it until then (`FactoryStatus`, `packages/objects/src/factory.ts`).

when a Factory's condition last changed its status, `True` to `False` or back, in the condition: a pass that writes the same status keeps it, and a condition written before it was kept has none (`FactoryCondition`, `packages/objects/src/factory.ts`).

what an McpServer's header value is served as, `********`, never a value a header is sent with: sent back on a write, it keeps the value the server holds, and for a header the server does not hold it is refused (`HEADER_MASK`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).

who fills a Hire's step, in its status: the step's own file (`step`), the factory's hire (`factory`), neither (`unfilled`), or both, which a start refuses (`refused`) (`FILL_ORIGINS`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).

where a setting a session on a Hire's step gets came from: the step's own file (`step`), its agent's file (`agent`), or neither, the harness's own default (`default`) (`SETTING_ORIGINS`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).

a Factory's sub-resource at `/api/factories/<name>/commands`: the lines a person types for it, built off the command table — attach, rm, add, schedule, trust, volume — and the line that takes back each schedule, by workflow, and each volume, by name (`FactoryCommands`, `packages/objects/src/factory.ts`).

a folder of steps a factory resolves, served in the factory's namespace: its `spec` its steps as their files write them, its `status` its origin, its typed graph, each step resolved and its revision (`Workflow`, `packages/objects/src/workflow.ts`).

an agent definition a factory resolves, served in the factory's namespace: its `spec` what its file says, its `status` where it was found, the steps it fills and the skills it gives (`Agent`, `packages/objects/src/agent.ts`).

a skill folder a factory's starts can find, served in the factory's namespace: its `spec` what its SKILL.md says, its `status` where it was found, what it costs a turn and who gives it (`Skill`, `packages/objects/src/skill.ts`).

where a definition is read from, in the order a factory looks a name up: `factory`, the factory's own tree; `repo`, the repository's checkout; `yours`, your library; `builtin`, what Nemia builds in (`DEFINITION_ORIGINS`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).

a definition another origin holds the name of first in its namespace: served only when its origin is asked for (`?origin=`), its `status.shadowedBy` naming that origin (`definitionStatus`, `packages/objects/src/definition.ts`).
what a node of a workflow's graph is: a `step`, a `condition` that routes, or a `workflow` node that files a card for another workflow (`NODE_KINDS`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).
what an edge of a workflow's graph says: `after`, a wait; `input`, an output handed on; `loop`, a round run again; `route`, a condition's route (`EDGE_KINDS`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).

a definition's number in the revision ledger for what its files hold now, read without a write: `status.revision` on a Workflow, an Agent and a Skill (`definitionStatus`, `packages/objects/src/definition.ts`).

a factory template Nemia builds in, served as an object no namespace holds, by its name: its manifest's spec as written, and in its status where it is read from, its content's digest, the names of its documents and what stops it being read (`Template`, `packages/objects/src/template.ts`). Applying it is a Factory's action.

one of a template's workflows, agents or skills, served under its template (`/api/templates/<name>/<plural>/<doc>`) in the Schema a namespace serves it in, rendered with the parameters' defaults, with origin `builtin` (`TemplatesGroup`, `packages/objects/src/api.ts`).

a runtime task told of the feed's lines its selectors match, served as an object no namespace holds: what was asked in its spec, where the deliverer is with it in its status (`Subscription`, `packages/objects/src/subscription.ts`).

one line of the feed served as an object, named by the byte its line starts at, in the namespace of the factory it names, or in none for a daemon's or the store's line that names none (`Event`, `packages/objects/src/event.ts`). It departs from Kubernetes' core/v1 Event on purpose: `involved` for its involvedObject, a `source` word for an EventSource, a closed `reason`, no count, firstTimestamp, lastTimestamp or series, and the line's time as `creationTimestamp`.
what an Event is about: a run, one of its steps, a daemon or the store, by its kind (`INVOLVED_KINDS`) and its name (`EventInvolved`, `packages/objects/src/event.ts`).

a page of the runs, across namespaces (`/api/runs`) or in one (`/api/namespaces/<factory>/runs`), each item a whole `Run`; beside its items, `unjudged`, the runs of the page that could not be judged (`RunList`, `packages/objects/src/run.ts`).
a run of a RunList's page a task of which does not read, so it is no `Run`: named in the list's `unjudged` with why, never dropped with no word (`RunUnjudged`, `packages/objects/src/run.ts`).

a verb on a run served at its own path under the run in its namespace, its body and answer Schemas of their own: start, removal, refresh, prune, labels, hold and its lift, and a step's retry, approval and words said (`RunStart`, `RunRetry`, `RunApprove`, `RunSay`, `RunRefresh`, `RunHold`, `RunPrune`, `packages/objects/src/run-actions.ts`). Each is a past fact on the run's record, as the command line's is.

a 502 a run's action answers when the package began it and something under it failed — the engine, git, a harness that did not take the words — naming the command that asks the same way (`WriteFailed`, `packages/objects/src/api.ts`).
a 400 a run's action answers for a request the api read and refused before the package was asked: a body that is no JSON, a name no run can have (`BadRequest`, `packages/objects/src/api.ts`).

what a watch of a list (`?watch=true`) sends, one per server-sent message: an object `ADDED`, `MODIFIED` or `DELETED`, or a `BOOKMARK` (`WATCH_EVENT_TYPES`, `watchEventOf`, `packages/objects/src/watch.ts`). A watch keeps nothing between connections: a reconnect is sent every object `ADDED` again, so a reader takes `ADDED` as an upsert.

a watch event whose object is the list's kind carrying a `resourceVersion` alone, saying every change up to it was sent; the first ends the initial state (`BookmarkObject`, `packages/objects/src/watch.ts`).

`GET /api`: every resource the api serves of nemia/v1, each a kind under its plural or a sub-resource of one (a run's hold), its scope and its verbs, read off the `Api` itself (`APIResourceList`, `DiscoveryGroup`, `packages/objects/src/discovery.ts`).
what a resource can be asked, in Kubernetes' words: `get`, `list`, `watch`, `create`, `update`, `patch`, `delete` (`RESOURCE_VERBS`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).
the word a kind's paths name its collection by, `/api/<plural>` and `/api/namespaces/<namespace>/<plural>` (`RESOURCE_PLURALS`, `packages/objects/src/api.ts`).

a card written whole, the body of the Card's update (`PUT /api/namespaces/<factory>/cards/<name>`, what `nemia apply` sends): its spec as it is to be, its labels, and the `resourceVersion` it was read at (`CardWrite`, `packages/objects/src/card.ts`).

one line saying what a key of a card's frontmatter means, in `CARD_KEYS`' order: the description of the Card's field that holds it, which `nemia explain` and the board's card page read (`CARD_KEY_MEANINGS`, `packages/objects/src/card.ts`).

a change of a factory's definitions and wiring, said as the objects apply takes, each at the `resourceVersion` it was read at, served in the factory's namespace: any agent of the factory makes one, the person approves it (or an agent at auto within its Delegation, under a rule the person confirmed), and it applies as a new revision (`Proposal`, `packages/objects/src/proposal.ts`).

what the person lets one agent approve in a factory unasked at auto, named by the agent: Kubernetes' Role and RoleBinding in one object, its rules the resources, the names among them and the verbs; none by default (`Delegation`, `packages/objects/src/delegation.ts`).
when an approved proposal applies: at approval, or at the successful end of the run that proposed it (`APPLY_AT`, `packages/objects/src/words.ts`).

whether a proposal reaches further than what it changes did: an allow gained, a deny lost, or a permission mode that reaches further; computed by the machinery, never an agent's claim (`ProposalStatus`, `packages/objects/src/proposal.ts`).
who made a proposal: the agent of the session that called, with its run and step, all absent for the person (`ProposedBy`, `packages/objects/src/proposal.ts`).
who approved a proposal: the person, or an agent under the rule named, and when (`ApprovedByOf`, `packages/objects/src/proposal.ts`).
